messages:
morgan: Rolling out release/2026.03.21 now. smokewatch started. seeing kv-probe fanout tail increase in us-west, p95 -> 420ms. not yet sure if this is noise.

sasha: thanks - do we have a quick diffs list? any changes to kv fanout throttling or routing?

morgan: no config changes to fanout. main diffs: small model variant bump (v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0), runtime patch for async prefetch, and latest kernel selection flags.

ryan: deploy-bot reports canary ok but mini-synth failing ~10% of runs. snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-21T14:02:18Z] kv-probe: batch fanout=128 -> latency spikes on tail, conn-reset from node-05
[2026-03-21T14:02:19Z] synth: p99 1.2s, p95 430ms
```

lucy: rolling probe failures line up with a brief host reclaim on node-05 earlier. infra showed short eviction (30s). could be noisy host.

morgan: hmm. smokewatch threshold crossed at 14:04. current suggestion: hold rollforward and evaluate quick mitigations. thoughts? :thinking_face:

sasha: +1 on hold. can we divert traffic off node-05 and re-run synth? also flag release notes to say model bump and runtime flag so we can correlate.

ryan: re-routing done: `infractl drain node-05 --reason "smokewatch kv tail"` — kicked off a rerun of the mini-synth.

deploy-bot: Canary finished (50rps). Summary: 40/50 synth runs passed, 10/50 failed. No errors in tokenization. Correlation: failures overlap with node-05 window.

morgan: ok that's leaning toward infrastructure noise. but we still saw p95 drift. safest is to keep rollforward paused and let infra validate host stability for 15m, then re-evaluate. if infra looks clean, rollforward with a small ramp to 10% then 100%.

lucy: infra confirmed node-05 had a transient OOM kill from a background job; eviction window 14:01:50 - 14:02:20. ops is remediating and will redeploy host image to avoid recurrence.

sasha: propose we update release notes to include a rollback trigger: if synth failure rate > 15% after ramp to 10%, immediate pin to v3.2.1 and revert runtime flag. also add routing fallback to legacy model variant.

morgan: agreed. I'll add a quick runbook in the release thread and set deploy-bot hold.

morgan: runbook snippet:
```
- hold rollforward
- drain affected host(s)
- rerun mini-synth (50 runs)
- if failures > 15%: pin to v3.2.1, revert runtime flag, notify customers via status page
- if failures <= 15%: continue to 10% traffic for 10m, monitor p95/p99, then full rollforward
```

deploy-bot: Rollforward hold set by morgan. Canary traffic frozen.

incidents-bot: Noted: change window 14:00-15:30 UTC. If rollback triggered, create incident with Sev3 and include canary artifacts.

ryan: rerun results: 50/50 passed after drain. p95 back at 180ms. looks stable.

lucy: infra patch applied to node image; no more OOM traces. ops scheduled a follow-up host draining policy change.

morgan: good. lifting hold. starting slow rollforward: 10% for 10m, then 100% if metrics hold. tagging release notes: "Model variant v3.3.0, runtime async prefetch flag enabled — watch kv fanout tail in us-west"

sasha: adding the rollback snippet to release notes and the quickcheck suite. also adding a synthetic that targets worst-case fanout to catch regressions.

morgan: thanks all. closing smokewatch thread — will post final status after 10m ramp. :white_check_mark:
